content_data.meeting_title: UX Redesign Sync: Global Booking Flow Optimization
agenda_items: Review current booking flow wireframes and user feedback
Align on next iteration's design priorities
Address accessibility considerations for new UI elements
Discuss visual design language consistency across regions
Brainstorm solutions for mobile responsiveness challenges
key_decisions: Adopt a modular design system approach to accelerate future UI developments.
Prioritize mobile-first design for the next iteration of the global booking flow.
Schedule dedicated workshop for accessibility audit and remediation of key user journeys.
